about: 2.49: extra paper accounts next to your main one (Mandeep, 10 Nov 2026, points 14 and 15). Each has its own money and its own trades (saved as source '<feed>#<id>', never mixed with the main account, the scorecard or the test bench). Paper only: nothing here can place a real order. 'pick' = which alerts the account takes; 'paper' = its account rules (same names as the main account's); capital null = the same as your main capital. Change the numbers here; old trades keep the rules they were taken with. 2.56: 'exit_style' (a chart exit from lab/exits.py STYLES) gives an account its own exit for every trade; pick.same_as_main takes the main account's alert types and strength. 2.56.2: pick.mirror_main takes exactly the main account's trades (same alert, same lots); the main account's limits decide. 2.58: pick.multiverse takes test-bench signals that match the multiverse's live picks (data/multiverse.json), with the pick's strike and exit. 2.59: paper.index_slots keeps that many open-trade slots for the indices (0 = as before).

best.name: Best only
best.explain: Takes an alert only when everything agrees: it is a Focus alert, strength 3, the risk check says PASS, the signal score is 70 or more, and that alert type has a good live record (20+ graded, 55%+ worked, option up on average after an hour) or it comes from a Strategy Lab rule that passed the strict out-of-sample bar. Few trades by design.

target3.name: 3% a day
target3.short: Aims for +3% of the account a day, top alerts only
target3.explain: Starts from the capital you type, adds every day's result to the next day (compounding). Takes only top alerts (Focus, strength 3, risk PASS, score 75+), one trade at a time. When the day's profit (booked + open) reaches 3% of the morning's money, it closes everything and stops for the day; at -2% it does the same. Honest note: 3% every day compounds to about 1,600 times in a year; no strategy tested so far does that, so this account measures how often a day reaches +3%, not a promise.

trail.name: Trailing exit
trail.short: Same trades as the main account, trailing exit
trail.explain: Takes exactly the trades the main account takes (2.56.2: the same alert, the same number of lots, at the same moment) and differs only in how it exits: stop 1.5 x the 5-minute ATR of the index or stock, then a stop that trails 2.5 x ATR behind the best price, no fixed target, out by the day's exit time. Only in the first minutes after the scanner starts (no 5-minute bars yet) can it miss a trade. Why: on 15,370 graded alerts (2-9 Nov) this exit made +2.0% more on the option per trade than the +30% / -20% premium exit, better on 5 of 6 days. Your call (11 Nov): test it here first; if it keeps beating the main account, switching the main account is your decision.

mvpick.name: Multiverse pick
mvpick.short: Takes only the multiverse's proven picks
mvpick.explain: Every evening the multiverse replays every test-bench signal of the recorded days down millions of timelines (which signals, strike, entry time, exit) and keeps only the few whose lower confidence bound is above zero after charges, with days (not signals) as the units of proof. This account takes a live signal only when it matches one of those picks, with the pick's strike and exit, 1 lot, its own money and rules. When nothing is proven it takes nothing. Paper only, on trial: compare it with the main account on Accounts side by side.

idxslot.name: Index slot
idxslot.short: The main account's alerts, 1 of its slots kept for the indices
idxslot.explain: Takes the same alert types and strength as the main account (risk check PASS, lots from its own money), but never fills its last open-trade slot with a stock: one slot stays free for Nifty / Bank Nifty / Fin Nifty / Midcap Select. Why (11 Nov 2026): the main account's 3 slots were full of stock trades at 10:30, so it bought the Bank Nifty breakout only at 10:42, about 150 points later. If this account beats the main one over the coming weeks, keeping a slot for the indices in the main account is your call.

ghanshyam.name: Ghanshyam
ghanshyam.short: Only Ghanshyam's strategies (course + 9:20), Nifty and Bank Nifty
ghanshyam.explain: Mandeep, 12 Nov 2026: a section of its own for Ghanshyam's strategies. This account takes only the signals of the Ghanshyam strategy files (rules/strategy_files/ghanshyam_course.json once uploaded) on Nifty and Bank Nifty: 1 lot each, once per strategy, symbol and day, the same paper rules (target, stop, time) as the main account. Own money and trades; never touches the main account. Every strategy here is still on trial.
